|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Maul (Holo AI) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee high-resolution card image of this version ([[:File:V13-D-maul_ai-2022-08-26-hires.png]]); no card-size GIF of this image was ever committed, which is why it was missing from the version list until the PC's high-resolution images were compared with the card-size images (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); a later copy of the same image in another format is not (13 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged; left = previous version, right = this image): [[File:V13-D-maul_ai-2022-08-26-hires-changes.png|frameless|upright=2]].
* '''Original''' ([[Maul (Holo AI)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 13 March 2022<ref name="img-altpng-8c5f1b9-maulaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/maul_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8c5f1b9da2aa1e1cc87074510be061086c339d76 commit 8c5f1b9] (13 March 2022) (“added maul and qira AI”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/maul_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; no “(AI)” label; bottom margin “Imbalance”. Text: “Never deploys to a battleground. Opponent may not cancel your destiny draws. Once per turn, may add 1 to a just drawn battle or weapon destiny. Once per turn, may subtract 1 from a just drawn battle or weapon destiny. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 26 August 2022<ref name="img-altpng-3ed4308-maulaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/maul_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3ed4308531b909a81d213db4d364fab8c38685fc commit 3ed4308] (26 August 2022) (“GEMP Series 4 AIs, fixes”). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; label “(AI)”; bottom margin “Imbalance”. Text: “Never deploys to a battleground. Opponent may not cancel your destiny draws. Once per turn, may add 1 to a just drawn battle or weapon destiny. Once per turn, may subtract 1 from a just drawn battle or weapon destiny.
